item.description:
Changes since v0.2.47:
- Update (#231) - A written first-run walkthrough and a live-website script follow a new person from the link to the first gesture (#230) - A refused camera now says the camera is needed and shows how to allow it in Safari, Firefox and Chrome (#229) - The home page headline and text now stop before the 3D scene at 1100, 1500 and 1920 px wide (#228) - The docs say the required checks run the usage triage tests on every pull request (#226) - The changelog says the auto-release workflow is the only automatic release path (#225) - The docs name the library release dry run as the Linux and Windows test check (#224) - The gotchas list states the signing certificate expiry date and the Developer ID grant reset (#223) - The portability page no longer states test counts and says where to read them (#222) - The home page hero tours the main screen, the side screen's top session and its non-Claude bottom window before it loops (#221) - The release guide states the signing certificate expires on 2036-10-11 (#220)

Changes since v0.2.46:
- The nose dot aims up to 40 ms ahead while it moves, and asks for 120 Hz only while moving fast (#218) - The built app drops Sparkle's 35 unused update-window translations and keeps the English one (#217)

Changes since core-v0.1.0:
- The face tracker bundle no longer ends with a pointer to a source map that does not ship (#216) - The download section shows one temporary note for the macOS warning instead of three steps (#215) - A portability page says what runs on which system and how it is checked (#214) - RELEASING.md names the release track of each operating system (#213)
